subfamily: whiskey Old-Fashioned served up (no ice), after the Codex root recipe (p. 5)
glass: small tumbler (about 200 ml), chilled in the freezer, no ice
version: v1 (Tomás, round 4). Codex root Old-Fashioned (p. 5) with one change: the sugar is a caramel syrup cooked to deep amber (LI p. 347 method; LI p. 137 row). One bourbon only (Blanton's Original Single Barrel, 46.5%, recommended; any single-barrel bourbon). Served up with no ice. Stronger barrels: bourbon + water always 60 ml, by the label (bands swept in mixologist-sweep-r4.md). Second bitters dropped and one orange twist only (Codex p. 12: aged whiskey, light hand).
